description: Dead-man's switch for the flap monitor itself. The monitor's error path (script failure, SUPERVISOR_TOKEN loss, log-fetch failure) lands binary_sensor.cameras_flapping in 'unavailable'; without this automation that state is terminal-silent. 60 min clears benign windows (HA/Scrypted restarts recover in 5-15 min). NOTE (corrected 2026-08-17): a cam_health death does NOT trip this - cam_vision.py probes the same 9 endpoints at the same cadence, so the probe stream merely halves; cam_health's own dead-man is camera_health_monitor_down. RE-ASSERTS hourly (:47) while the sensor stays dead (restart-wipe guard).

data.title: 📹 Flap monitor down
